findings.title: Exit-code contract for disabled feature is not tested
findings.body: The new behavior exposes exit code 4 as the machine-readable result when `rolling-updates` is disabled, and the documentation instructs automation to rely on that code. This test only checks stderr, so a regression returning a generic Picocli/software-error code would still pass. Assert the result exit code for this disabled-feature invocation; similarly, the incompatible-version paths should assert the newly assigned recreate exit code 3.
